description: Finish or skip one BAMF Bot setup step and save it on the same record as the web onboarding, so the person can continue on bamf.ai or here. Optionally saves their answer for the step and their profile basics (name, website, LinkedIn, role, industry, bio). Returns the updated onboarding status, including any credit rewards BAMF verified.

answer.description: What the person said for this step (small JSON object, 8 KB max).

creator_id.description: Creator space being onboarded. Defaults to the person's own.

step.description: Step id from bamf.get_onboarding (for example sources, first-posts, engagement).

name: bamf.advance_onboarding
